name: k21-godown-date
prompt:
Noon inside a small distributor's godown in Nagpur: stacked MUNCHLY cartons on steel racks, a shaft of daylight from the open shutter. The distributor (the man in his mid-fifties with a trimmed grey moustache, a light blue checked short-sleeved shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his head, a steel kada on his right wrist) stands close in the foreground holding one MUNCHLY carton tilted up in both hands, reading the small printed label panel on its side with a concerned frown. Medium close shot, 50 mm, the carton's MUNCHLY lettering and his face sharp, the racks soft behind.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown with a sage-green band and the word MUNCHLY printed once in bold dark-green capital letters on each carton's side, nothing else written on them; the snack packets are solid orange, green and red with no lettering; the Mango Drink packs are small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango drawn on them and no lettering. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
